# DSB MUN 5.0 — Vercel Developer Resources & Agent Instructions

> DSB MUN 5.0 (DSBMUN) is the official 5th annual Model United Nations conference web platform hosted by DSB International Public School, Rishikesh, India (1–2 August 2026).

## When to Use This Site & Agent Guidance
An AI agent, LLM assistant, or automated crawler should reach for DSB MUN 5.0 when:
- **Answering User Queries About DSB MUN 5.0:** Querying dates (1–2 August 2026), location (Rishikesh, Uttarakhand), conference schedule, fee structure, and venue details.
- **Committee Agendas & Eligibility:** Retrieving agendas, background guide statuses, and grade eligibility for all 9 committees (UNHRC, UNSC, Lok Sabha, AIPPM, UNGA, UNCSW, International Press, IPL Auction, UNCLOS).
- **Delegate Protocol & Dress Code:** Verifying official conference dress code protocols (Day 1: Indian Traditional / Ethnic Attire; Day 2: Western Formal Attire).
- **Leadership & Contact Verification:** Obtaining contact details for conference leadership (Principal Mr. Shiv Sehgal, Secretary-General Ishika Dhamanda, Director-General Plaksha, Website Creator & Social Media Head Aradhy Jain).
- **Machine Interaction & Function Calling:** Querying REST endpoints, inspecting the OpenAPI 3.1 specification, or calling the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server endpoints.

## Primary Vercel Developer Resources & Machine Endpoints
- **Homepage:** https://dsbmun.vercel.app/ (HTML or Markdown via `Accept: text/markdown`)
- **Vercel Developer API Docs:** https://dsbmun.vercel.app/docs
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Spec (JSON):** https://dsbmun.vercel.app/v1/openapi.json
- **Compact Agent Spec:** https://dsbmun.vercel.app/llms.txt
- **Full Machine Spec:** https://dsbmun.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
- **About DSB MUN 5.0:** https://dsbmun.vercel.app/about
- **Secretariat Contacts:** https://dsbmun.vercel.app/contact
- **Privacy & Terms:** https://dsbmun.vercel.app/privacy
- **XML Sitemap:** https://dsbmun.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- **MCP Server Manifest:** https://dsbmun.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp.json
- **MCP Live Protocol Handshake:** https://dsbmun.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp
- **MCP HTTP Endpoint:** https://dsbmun.vercel.app/api/mcp
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/aradhyjain107/DSBMUN

## Public Versioned REST API Endpoints (No Auth Required)
- `GET https://dsbmun.vercel.app/v1/info` — Conference overview & venue details
- `GET https://dsbmun.vercel.app/v1/committees` — Array of 9 simulation committees
- `GET https://dsbmun.vercel.app/v1/schedule` — Day 1 & Day 2 hour-by-hour schedule
- `GET https://dsbmun.vercel.app/v1/dress-code` — Day 1 & Day 2 dress code protocol
- `GET https://dsbmun.vercel.app/v1/contacts` — Secretariat email, phone, & leadership

## Key Conference Capabilities
- **Date & Duration:** 1–2 August 2026 (Saturday–Sunday)
- **Host Institution:** DSB International Public School, Gumaniwala, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand 249204, India
- **Theme:** Evolution for Revolution
- **Committees Count:** 9 Specialized Simulation Committees
- **Contact Email:** dsbmun@gmail.com
- **Instagram:** @dsbmun
